definitions.simulator: Status under the Step 6.1b simulator policy (graph topology given the bus access flags). Not a statement about law.

evidence.verifiedAccess: Restored through a provenance-backed access record (road-access.json: verified route 21 service or explicit bus/psv tag).
evidence.turnaroundRestoration: Restored because the branch ends at a mapped OSM turning facility. Branch roads are importer bus classes with no known restriction; bus operation is not verified.
evidence.verifiedRestriction: Every blocking road carries an explicit OSM bus prohibition or a limit below bus dimensions.
evidence.graphTopology: Every seed is a full-graph directed terminal: no vehicle can continue, independent of access.
evidence.unresolvedAccess: Blocked only by roads without explicit restrictions, closed by the simulator class heuristic. Not evidence of a legal prohibition; kept closed for lack of operational evidence.

definitions.seed: Node where the pruning cascade starts; blockingRoads are its outgoing roads the bus policy does not permit.
